subject: Legendary Team
text: A commenter suggests that the Legendary Team win count only considers the last game, because losses are not counted toward the 27 wins.

evidence.quote: Second, it would seem that only the last game matters, as the other addresses won't matter until you get 27 wins (it doesn't account loses)
